cornerstone.holders: Glencore AG; Stoneylake Global; North Rock; ChinaAMC (HK); New Asia Ferrell; Bridge Zone Group; Zhengxin Group; Sunwoda Treasury
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that without the prior written consent of each of the Company, the Overall Coordinators and the Sole Sponsor, it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period commencing from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date and ending on (and inclusive of) the date falling six (6) months after the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), directly or indirectly dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares it has subscribed for or any interest in any company or entity holding any of such Offer Shares pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreements. Except for the forgoing lock-up, Glencore AG has also agreed to an additional restriction on disposal of, in any way, an aggregate more than one third of the Offer Shares it has subscribed for at any time during the period commencing from (and inclusive of) the last day of the Lock-up Period and ending on the date falling 30 months after (and inclusive of) the last day of the Lock-up Period.
cornerstone.basis: restricted period inclusive of both the Listing Date and the date falling six months after the Listing Date (document: both endpoints expressly inclusive); first free day is the day after the six-month anniversary
cornerstone.notes: Glencore AG additionally agreed a voluntary tiered restriction: after the six-month Lock-up Period it will not dispose of more than one third of its subscribed Offer Shares during the 30 months following the last day of the Lock-up Period.

controller_6m.full_quote: in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of his shareholding is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date, either directly or indirectly, dispose of, enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares or securities of the Company in respect of which he is shown by this prospectus to be the beneficial owner(s) (the “Relevant Securities”) (save for a pledge or charge of any Relevant Securities as security in favour of an authorized institution (as defined in the Banking Ordinance (Chapter 155 of the Laws of Hong Kong)) for a bona fide commercial loan); and
controller_6m.basis: six calendar months from the Listing Date; restricted period ends on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (inclusive end per document wording: “ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date”); period commences on the prospectus disclosure date (H-share Rule 10.07(1)(a) form)

controller_12m.full_quote: in the period of six months commencing on the date on which the period referred to in the preceding paragraph expires, either directly or indirectly, dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create, any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Relevant Securities, if immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, it/he would cease to be a Controlling Shareholder of our Company.
controller_12m.basis: control-preserving no-disposal undertaking covering the second six months, ending 12 months from the Listing Date (inclusive end); second period commences on expiry of the first six-month period (H-share combined Rule 10.07(1) rendering)
controller_12m.notes: Combined H-share rendering: control-preserving restriction expressed as the second six-month period clause (months 6-12).
